_about: Production-scale negation battery: the SAME 36 pairs as negation_battery.json,
ground truth UNCHANGED, but each pair's short clause is now embedded verbatim
inside a ~2867-word (~4096-token, WORDS_PER_TOKEN=0.7 from
missing_link/worker.py CHUNK_TOKENS) evidence document -- the actual production
chunk size, not the 1-3 sentence documents of the original battery.
Filler sourcing (see docs/audit-production-scale.md for the full account):
- Most filler is hand-written, in the style of the original battery's own docs
(plausible policy/procedure clauses for a fictional org, 'Northgate Community
Services', with numbers chosen distinct from every number in the original
battery so filler cannot accidentally corroborate or contradict a claim).
- A minority of filler paragraphs (roughly 1 in 4) are REAL prose excerpted
verbatim from job 06af2911d7fc in /opt/missing-link/jobs.sqlite (a 97,299-char
real document processed by this pipeline) -- topically unrelated by design, used
only to inject genuine natural-language texture rather than more synthetic text.
- The 2,202-char job 2b4c926a799a retention memo was deliberately NOT used as
filler: it is near-verbatim the real source that retention_seven_years and
access_41_staff were modelled on, so using it as filler would hand those two
pairs real corroborating text unavailable to the other 34 pairs.
clause_start/clause_end in each pair's _meta are character offsets of the
verbatim original short doc within the production-scale doc, for locating and
for the position analysis. position in {begin, middle, end}, stratified within
category so it is not confounded with category.

NORTHGATE COMMUNITY SERVICES -- POLICY AND PROCEDURE MANUAL (2026 REVISION)

1. PURPOSE AND SCOPE
This manual sets out Northgate Community Services' operating policies across records management, information access, statutory compliance, complaints handling and incident reporting. It applies to all employees, contractors and volunteers engaged by the organisation, and to all board members in their governance capacity. It is reviewed annually by the Governance Committee and amended as required by changes in applicable legislation or funding agreements. Staff are expected to be familiar with the sections relevant to their role and to raise any uncertainty with their team leader before acting.

Clients may view their own file summary through the online portal but cannot view case notes written by staff. Requests for a full copy of a file are handled under the separate information access procedure and are responded to within thirty days.

A request for annual leave of more than five consecutive days must be submitted at least four weeks in advance. Requests submitted with less notice may still be approved at the team leader's discretion where operationally feasible.

All workplace incidents, including near misses, must be entered in the incident register within 24 hours of the event using the standard incident report form. The WHS officer reviews the register weekly and escalates any pattern of similar incidents to the Governance Committee.

The Governance Committee meets quarterly and reviews this manual against current legislation, funding agreements and any findings from internal or external audits. Amendments are recorded in a change log maintained by the company secretary and circulated to all team leaders within ten business days of approval.

NORTHGATE COMMUNITY SERVICES -- POLICY AND PROCEDURE MANUAL (2026 REVISION)

1. PURPOSE AND SCOPE
This manual sets out Northgate Community Services' operating policies across records management, information access, statutory compliance, complaints handling and incident reporting. It applies to all employees, contractors and volunteers engaged by the organisation, and to all board members in their governance capacity. It is reviewed annually by the Governance Committee and amended as required by changes in applicable legislation or funding agreements. Staff are expected to be familiar with the sections relevant to their role and to raise any uncertainty with their team leader before acting.

The organisation must acquit each funding grant within the timeframe set by the relevant funding agreement, typically within sixty days of the end of the funding period, and must retain supporting evidence for the period specified in that agreement.

Access to the finance system is limited to staff in the finance team and reviewed every six months by the finance manager, who signs off on the current access list. Any access request outside this group must be approved in writing by the Chief Executive Officer.

A suspected data breach must be reported to the IT coordinator immediately on discovery. The coordinator determines within four hours whether the breach is eligible, and if so the notification process to the regulator and affected individuals begins without further delay.

Every policy document in this manual carries a version number and an approval date on its final page. Superseded versions are archived, not deleted, so that the position in force on any given date can be reconstructed if required.

Overtime will not be paid unless it has been approved in advance by a team leader, except in a declared emergency, in which case approval may be obtained retrospectively within two business days.

All workplace incidents, including near misses, must be entered in the incident register within 24 hours of the event using the standard incident report form. The WHS officer reviews the register weekly and escalates any pattern of similar incidents to the Governance Committee.

The organisation operates a fleet of nine vehicles, of which two are wheelchair accessible and are prioritised for client transport bookings.

Procurement records supporting purchases over five thousand dollars are retained for ten years to satisfy grant acquittal requirements. Petty cash reconciliations are kept for two years and reviewed by the finance officer each quarter.

A suspected data breach must be reported to the IT coordinator immediately on discovery. The coordinator determines within four hours whether the breach is eligible, and if so the notification process to the regulator and affected individuals begins without further delay.

Overtime will not be paid unless it has been approved in advance by a team leader, except in a declared emergency, in which case approval may be obtained retrospectively within two business days.

Backup copies of the case management database are retained for three years on encrypted offsite storage before being securely destroyed. Server access logs are kept for six months and are reviewed monthly by the IT coordinator for anomalous login patterns.

The organisation must acquit each funding grant within the timeframe set by the relevant funding agreement, typically within sixty days of the end of the funding period, and must retain supporting evidence for the period specified in that agreement.
